headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Naylor leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. Andrés Muñoz earned the save, striking out 2 batters in 1 inning of work. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Boston Red Sox 3-1, with Casey Legumina earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save. Yandy Díaz led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups. Carlos Rodriguez, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026. Adam Frazier, a second baseman for the Los Angeles Angels, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 6, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. Vaughn Grissom, also a second baseman for the Los Angeles Angels, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 5, 2026, due to a left oblique strain. Yoán Moncada, a third baseman for the Los Angeles Angels, has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right knee inflammation.

The Arizona Diamondbacks traded right-handed pitcher Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Texas Rangers traded shortstop Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded left-handed pitcher Antoine Kelly to the Chicago Cubs for cash. The Athletics traded right-handed pitcher Joel Kuhnel to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash.

top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 5-2 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Cristopher Sánchez earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 10 strikeouts.
